title: Convertible Rear Seat Backrest Removal and Installation
introduction:
The convertible backrest has floor fasteners and upper locking clips. I read it like a panel hung on catches: releasing the visible floor attachments does not finish the job. Removing the cushion first exposes those lower attachments; the backrest then lifts out after its locking clips are released.

This guide covers the convertible configurations listed for this article and includes the linked cushion preparation. Release the upper hooked clips before lifting, then restore their engagement before tightening the floor fasteners.

items.name: Prevent an unexpected start
items.detail: Park on level ground with the parking brake applied and wheels chocked; keep P selected on an automatic or a parked gear on a manual. Keep the engine stopped throughout. Disable remote start, if equipped, through Vehicle settings > Remote Start Setup before dismantling anything. Otherwise, someone could remotely start the car, causing personal injury or death. If the setting needs ignition power, keep the valid intelligent access key inside. From confirmed OFF, press and release START/STOP without pressing either pedal to select engine-off ON. If already ON for the settings, leave it ON rather than toggling it. After the setting change, return ON to OFF by pressing and releasing the button without pressing a pedal; if already OFF, leave it OFF. With the ignition OFF, remove the key from the vehicle before service to prevent another person from starting the engine; an accidental start may cause serious personal injury.

items.name: Protect yourself while handling the seat
items.detail: Wear eye and ear protection during vehicle service. Wear protective gloves when handling pointed or sharp seat-frame edges and attachments. Failure to use the required protection may result in serious personal injury.

items.name: Prepare for reassembly
items.detail: Have a torque wrench available for the backrest floor fasteners. Keep the seat-to-body contact areas and internal seat joints clear of objects, and plan to leave the belt webbing untwisted with the belts and buckles accessible.

items.name: Position the front seats before cushion work
items.detail: Keep everyone and all objects clear of the seat travel; never adjust the driver seat while the vehicle is moving. Move both front seats fully forward using their fitted controls. For manual seats, lift the bar beneath the front of the cushion, slide the seat forward, release the bar and rock the seat backward and forward to confirm that it locks. For power seats, move the outboard seat-control switch forward. If power is needed, bring the valid key inside and use the confirmed OFF-to-engine-off-ON sequence above without pressing either pedal. Once the seats are positioned, return any known ON state to OFF using the button with both pedals released; leave a state already OFF alone. With the ignition OFF, remove the key from the vehicle before releasing the rear cushion.

edits.text: WARNING: These steps are critical to correct seat-component installation. Carefully follow every instruction and note. Do not leave objects between the seat components and the vehicle body or inside any joint within the seat structure. Failure to follow these instructions can cause incorrect seat-component operation and increase the risk of serious personal injury.
edits.why: The attachments and joints must seat as intended; an object trapped in their load path can interfere with correct installation.

edits.text:
Remove the rear seat cushion to expose the lower backrest attachments.
Refer to: [Rear Seat Cushion](#/document/G1692168) (501-10B Rear Seats, Removal and Installation).
edits.why: Move both front seats fully forward using the fitted controls and known-state power sequence in preparation. Beneath the front edge of the rear cushion, locate the floor-locking tabs under the outer seating positions. Press the tabs inward to release the cushion from the floor, then lift, release and remove the cushion. Press before lifting: pulling the cushion without releasing the tabs can damage them.

edits.text:
Release the backrest-to-floor fasteners at the lower outer corners shown in the drawing. When reinstalling them, tighten to:
Torque: 35 lb.ft (47.5 Nm)
edits.why: With the cushion removed, the drawing identifies the floor attachments beside the lower ends of the backrest. Releasing these attachments leaves the locking clips to be disengaged before the backrest can come out.

edits.text: Release the locking clips at the upper rear of the backrest. Once the clips are disengaged, lift the backrest upward and remove it.
edits.why: The hooked locking clips sit behind the upper backrest frame. Pivot each clip inward, toward the backrest, out of engagement with its body catch before lifting the backrest upward. Releasing the catches and lifting the assembly are separate movements; I finish the first before asking the seat to move.

edits.text: NOTE: During installation, keep the safety-belt webbing untwisted and leave the safety belts and buckles accessible to the occupant.
edits.why: Check the belt routing as the backrest and cushion return to position, while any trapped or twisted webbing is still visible.

edits.text: Install in reverse removal order: lower the backrest into position and engage its locking clips, then secure its floor fasteners to the torque specified above. Reinstall the rear cushion by reversing its removal: position it, lower it into place and re-engage its front floor-locking tabs. Keep the safety belts and buckles accessible throughout reassembly.
edits.why: The backrest attachments go together before the cushion covers the lower mounting area. I finish by checking the belt webbing and buckle access—the upholstery can look tidy while hiding a buckle that the next passenger actually needs. Lower the backrest into its mountings, reversing its upward removal, and pivot the hooked locking clips into engagement with their body catches. Confirm engagement and seating before tightening the floor fasteners. Restore the front seats using the same fitted controls: for manual seats, lift the front bar, slide to the required position, release and rock to confirm locking; for power seats, move the outboard switch backward as required with everyone and all objects clear. If power is needed, bring the key inside and select engine-off ON only from confirmed OFF, with both pedals released. After positioning, return known ON to OFF with the button and both pedals released; do not toggle a state already OFF. With the ignition OFF, remove the key from the vehicle. Keep the car parked and restrained throughout, and do not use a seat that is not securely retained.

originalAuthorHold: The backrest illustration locates the upper locking clips and clearly shows upward backrest removal, but the inset does not unambiguously establish the hand contact point or exact clip-release movement. Clarify that manipulation and its reverse engagement before publishing this as a complete repair guide.
